US8509827B2.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

Context-Data Acquisition And Ranking.description: A method of determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to a specified parameter.

Context-Data Type.description: A classification of context data determined from a query, where the type provides information about an environment of a mobile device and may be determined by the meaning of a term of a short message.

Context-Data Source.description: A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter.

Context Data.description: Information about an environment of a mobile device that is received from a context-data source and may be ranked, provided to devices, associated with or appended to a short message, or stored in a database.

Short Message.description: A message received from a mobile device by a server, whose term meaning may determine a context-data type, and to which received context data may be associated, appended, or encoded.

Mobile Device.description: A device that generates and sends a short message and may receive context data; its environment is described by the context-data type.

Server.description: A system component that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.

Recipient Mobile Device.description: A mobile device that receives context data, may receive a forwarded short message with context data, and may access a database storing the received context data.

Specified Parameter.description: A criterion used to rank context-data sources or received context data, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.

Pecuniary Cost.description: A monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.

Database.description: A storage system available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored and queried.

Database Server.description: A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to enable access to stored context data.

Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).description: An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.

Markup Language.description: A language used to encode received context data into a short message.

Metadata Instructions.description: Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.

Query.description: A request from which a context-data type is determined and which may be generated by a device.

Communication Network.description: A network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking context data.
